'''LB-K2''', or '''Elbie''', was part of the initial test run of a few hundred [[LB-series courier droid]]s developed by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. She was shipped to [[Premier Provisions]] on the planet of [[Tyed Kant]], but when she arrived on [[Sprawl 34]] it was already devastated by the [[Mynock virus]]. She was discovered by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] agents, and discovered that her protected programming made her mostly immune to the Mynock virus. She proved invaluable during the resolution of the crisis.<ref name="MC" />
